scripts.build:production: npm run preflight && npm run build && node scripts/check-dist.mjs --production
scripts.release:check: npm run test && npm run test:emulators && npm run build:production && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-kinlift 'vitest run tests/firestore.rules.test.ts'
scripts.test:auth: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-kinlift 'vitest run tests/auth.emulator.test.ts'
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-kinlift 'vitest run tests/auth.emulator.test.ts tests/firestore.rules.test.ts'
